permitted_exact_links: GTEx histologyImageId equals the filename stem of an AnVIL SVS record
GTEx histology sampleId equals GTEx V8 SAMPID
forbidden_inferences: Do not turn a DICOM ContainerIdentifier ending in 25 into a GTEx histology ID ending in 26.
Do not describe the histology block and molecular block as the same section.
Do not assign a GTEx API row to an IDC series without a publisher crosswalk.
Do not infer that a missing API, AnVIL, or IDC record was removed for quality reasons.
count_interpretation: The counts come from different publisher snapshots and namespaces. Their arithmetic differences are reported, not treated as identified missing slides.
